title: FB-026 skip hidden rows during table keyboard navigation
summary: Fix FR-026 by making shared WebView selectable-table keyboard navigation ignore hidden rows.
reason: Worker finding W07-002 showed ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigation could focus and select rows hidden by enhanced table filters.
behavior_before: selectableRowsFor returned every selectable row in a tbody, including rows hidden by filters or CSS, so keyboard navigation could select invisible rows.
behavior_after: selectableRowsFor filters out rows hidden by table filters, aria-hidden, display:none, visibility:hidden, or visibility:collapse before keyboard navigation chooses the next row.
